decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers draw directly on the firm's core heat transfer know-how and in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret field and service feedback and keep refining the product as a component across its cooler portfolio.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are a core-technology component that the firm's own R&D and EU research cooperation are well placed to improve, and they feed efficiency gains into many exchanger types, so keeping them strengthens the established business.
